wikirealms-launch-pitch: Every Wikipedia article is a world. Its sections become mountain ranges, its references grow the forests, and its links are portals out.
wikirealms-launch-suggestions-label: Or begin somewhere on English Wikipedia
wikirealms-search-hint: Searching leaves the world you are in and starts a new journey. To carry on from here, take a portal. Press $1 to stay.
wikirealms-scrim-trail-aria: Your trail, $1 {{PLURAL:$1|realm|realms}} — path kept and shareable
wikirealms-scrim-trail-title: Your trail — the path you have walked. Open to revisit stops or share it.
wikirealms-settings-show-all-wikipedias-: Language is chosen when you search. Turn this on to list every open edition in that picker, not only the featured set.
wikirealms-settings-rendering-help: High always draws the world in 3D. Low uses the flat canvas, which asks less of the device. Auto picks by what the browser can do.
wikirealms-settings-travel-animation-hel: The dive between worlds. Turn it off for an immediate arrival — the system's reduced-motion setting already does this on its own.
wikirealms-settings-sections-help: Section halos and energy walls. Subsections reveal on hover.
wikirealms-settings-foliage-help: Trees, grass, and scrub matching each biome.
wikirealms-settings-chrome-help: How present the panels are over the world. Text stays at full contrast in all three — the old opacity slider dimmed the words along with the panel.
wikirealms-share-explore: Explore $1 as a world on WikiRealms
wikirealms-share-realm-hint-named: A link to $1 as a world
wikirealms-share-trail-hint: Your path through $1 {{PLURAL:$1|realm|realms}} as a postcard
wikirealms-share-trail-need-realm: Open a realm first, then share the path you walked
wikirealms-tools-share-hint: This realm, or the trail you walked
wikirealms-tools-about-hint: What this is and how it works
wikirealms-helm-legend-hint: Open Legend to learn the map
wikirealms-legend-ground-heading: The ground is how well each section cites
wikirealms-legend-dismiss-desktop: Press L or click the world to put this away.
wikirealms-legend-dismiss-mobile: Tap the world or close to put this away.
wikirealms-legend-ceiling-note: These compare sections within one article. A poorly sourced article stays dry throughout, however uneven it is — the greens are only available to an article that cites well overall.
wikirealms-legend-range-label: A mountain range is a section
wikirealms-legend-range-detail: Its height comes from that section’s own prose, and its breadth from everything nested beneath it.
wikirealms-legend-portal-label: A portal is an outbound link
wikirealms-legend-portal-detail: Up to $1 across a world, and at most $2 per mountain range (lead links have their own small budget). They are spread across the sections rather than taken from the top, and placed in the range whose section links there. Taking one starts a new world.
wikirealms-legend-water-detail: A short article floods; a long, detailed one drains and shows more land.
wikirealms-legend-snow-label: Rock and snow are how much was written
wikirealms-legend-snow-detail: A section's own prose is what raises its peak. Stone starts showing through at $1 of the world's height and has covered the ground by $2; snow begins at $3. Both come on gradually, and they tint rather than replace: a well-sourced section's high ground is damp, mossy stone where a barren one's is dry scree, and its trees climb higher before giving out. The polar ice is the exception — every world has it.
wikirealms-legend-foliage-label: Trees and grass grow from how well a section cites
wikirealms-legend-foliage-detail: Greener ground hosts denser understory and canopy. Altitude thins them toward the treeline; barren bands stay bare. The same lushness that paints the ground is what decides how much grows on it.
wikirealms-legend-creatures-label: Fish in the seas show how many people read the article
wikirealms-legend-creatures-detail: Thirty-day pageviews fill the oceans with fish: quieter pages stay sparse, busier ones host denser schools. Wikipedia categories tint which species appear (reef fish nearer the shelf, larger ones in deeper water). Land stays clear of animals.
wikirealms-band-wooded-ground: Trees, with ground still showing between them
wikirealms-cta-cite-tooltip: $1 — $2. Select this peak in the Ledger for how to help.
wikirealms-cta-cite-field-barren: $1 ground — no references yet. Open the section on Wikipedia and see what still needs a source.
wikirealms-cta-cite-field: $1 ground — $2. Citations grow the forest; open the section on Wikipedia to help.
wikirealms-cta-cite-seed-section: Help seed $1 with citations on Wikipedia
wikirealms-cta-cite-add-section: Help add citations to $1 on Wikipedia
wikirealms-cta-sparse-article-barren: Barren ground — this realm cites almost nothing yet. Open the article on Wikipedia and seed it with sources; citations grow the forest.
wikirealms-cta-sparse-article: Sparse ground — thin references across the article. Citations grow the forest; open it on Wikipedia to help seed what is missing.
wikirealms-cta-sparse-article-seed-label: Help seed this article with citations on Wikipedia
wikirealms-cta-sparse-article-add-label: Help add citations to this article on Wikipedia
wikirealms-cta-grow-small-notice: This map is still flooding — short articles leave little land above the water. Enlarge the article on Wikipedia and the realm grows with it.
wikirealms-cta-stale-label: View the latest — or help keep it accurate
wikirealms-cta-trail-lead: You have walked the network — Wikipedia stays free because people fund and edit it.
wikirealms-cta-guide-lead: Barren slopes need citations. Flooded maps need prose. Wikipedia is free because people fund and edit it.
wikirealms-ledger-less-open: Show less — peek at this place
wikirealms-ledger-stat-citations-hint: How well sections cite — trees and green
wikirealms-ledger-stat-portals-hint: Outbound links you can travel through
